name: copylot-accelerated-website
description: Official website for CoPylot-Accelerated, accelerated heliostat-field optical simulation.

scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs
scripts.test:releases: RELEASES_FIXTURE=tests/fixtures/releases.json ASTRO_OUT_DIR=dist-fixture astro build && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs dist-fixture --expect-release
scripts.test:prerelease: RELEASES_FIXTURE=tests/fixtures/releases-prerelease.json ASTRO_OUT_DIR=dist-fixture astro build && node scripts/check-built-site.mjs dist-fixture --expect-prerelease
